column1: # The network corpus of `anthology check-repo` (ci/jobs/check-repo-corpus.sh): real, well-known
# repositories that must scan with no HIGH or CRITICAL finding, in under 5 seconds each ("no
# false alarms", plan Global Constraints). One row per repository: the clone URL, a tab, and the
# commit it is pinned to (a full 40-character SHA, from `git ls-remote <url> HEAD` on the day it
# was added). Blank lines and lines that start with # are ignored.
# A pin keeps the run repeatable: a new upstream commit cannot turn the job red by itself. To move
# a pin, take the new SHA from `git ls-remote <url> HEAD`, run the job (workflow_dispatch), and look
# at what it prints for every MEDIUM finding. A real HIGH or CRITICAL finding on one of these is a
# false alarm in a rule: fix the rule, never the row.
